verdict.rationale: Linear ships automations as Loops, recurring agent workflows run on a schedule or triggered by events, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents versioning, reviewing, or rolling back a loop's definition. The 'restore to any previous checkpoint from version history' line does not say what is versioned, and the author-name indicators only show which text a loop wrote, not changes to the automation itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
